description: The fourth is not bound by cause or effect, has no seed-sleep, sleep or dream, and is called all-seeing and non-dual; it is reached when the two errors (dream, not knowing the truth) are exhausted.
Yogins fear the contactless yoga, seeing fear where there is fearlessness; it is hard for all yogins to see.
The mind that is absorbed (laya) in deep sleep is unlike the restrained mind, which is not absorbed; the restrained mind is called fearless brahman with the light of knowledge on every side.

Unborn, sleepless, dreamless, nameless, formless, shining once for all, omniscient; free of speech and thought; motionless, fearless samādhi; neither absorbed nor distracted, motionless, without appearance; self-abiding, peaceful, inexpressible, highest happiness.
Steady abiding of one who has turned back and does not proceed; unborn, sleepless, dreamless, it dawns of itself and is ever once-shone.
